name: capability-scene
description: Four capability cards in two columns around a centre panel holding the assistant artwork. Live: .apx-int on /asset-intelligence-platform/.

eyebrow.description: Small label above the heading. Also names the section for assistive tech.

title_accent.description: Part of the heading painted with the brand gradient.

title_accents.description: More parts of the heading painted with the gradient (strings), after title_accent.

left.description: Cards in the left column. Each: kicker, title, body.

right.description: Cards in the right column. Each: kicker, title, body.

lines.description: Lines at the top of the centre panel. Each: accent (the gradient word) and text.

lines_size.description: Centre-panel lines: md 16px/700 (Asset Intelligence Platform), lg 20px/800 in a taller 510px panel (Ursa AI frame 7261:111783).

meet.description: Sentence under those lines. The link label is substituted into it.

image.description: Artwork at the foot of the centre panel.

cta_label.description: Solid button under the cards (with cta_url).

secondary_label.description: Outline button, drawn before the solid one (with secondary_url).
